title: Don't open an issue to report problems with the latest Nightly
symptom: Users are opening new issues to report problems with the latest Nightly build, flooding the issues platform.
fix: Post problems with the latest Nightly in the open issue #1796 instead of opening a new issue.
evidence_quote: If you are experiencing any issues with the latest Nightly, please post in this open issue: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1796 Please DON'T open a new issue.
